admission_price: Farm Fun Standard $22 Per Person (Fridays 4:00pm - Sundays); Farm Fun Unlimited $32 Per Person (Fridays 4:00pm - Sundays); Children 2 and under are free. Additional charges for pony rides, face painting, gemstone mining, gellyball, and bull riding. Weekday pricing not listed on site.

extra_notes: Hours vary by day: Tues-Thurs 12:00pm-7:00pm (closed Oct 6), Fri 3:00pm-9:00pm, Sat 10:00am-9:00pm, Sun 10:00am-8:00pm, closed Mondays. Many activities available only on weekends (Fri-Sun). Pony rides close at 6:00pm and are limited to children under 10 weighing less than 90 lbs. Mechanical bull riding ages 5+. Guinea pig feeding until 6pm weekends only. Groups must register in advance (15+ paying individuals required for group discount). Birthday parties, school field trips, and corporate events available. All ticket sales are final, no refunds.
